name: blackrose-monorepo
description: Root scripts for Blackrose packages and docs

scripts.install:all: bun run install:python && bun run install:js && bun run install:docs
scripts.lint: bun run lint:python && bun run lint:js
scripts.lint:python: cd packages/python && uv run ruff check src tests && uv run ruff format --check src tests
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:python && bun run typecheck:js
scripts.typecheck:python: cd packages/python && uv run mypy src
scripts.test: bun run test:python && bun run test:js
scripts.test:python: cd packages/python && uv run pytest -m "not live"
scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:docs
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
